name: com.stockexpertai/research
title: Stock Expert AI Research
description: MoonshotScore ratings, pillar scores, comparisons, ranked screens and earnings dates for US stocks.

tools.name: stockexpertai_get_stock_summary
tools.description:
Get Stock Expert AI's research summary for one US-listed stock: MoonshotScore (0-100, educational rating), band (Exceptional / Strong / Fair / Weak), grade, which scoring engine produced it, the five pillar scores (0-100, sector-relative), the engine's one-line read, one-sentence bull and bear case, score and analysis dates, next provider-listed earnings date and the canonical page URL. Price, market cap and P/E are not returned: full figures on the page (canonicalUrl).

Covers one ticker per call, e.g. "what does Stock Expert AI say about NVDA", "NVDA MoonshotScore", "NVDA bull vs bear case".

Args: ticker (string) — US ticker symbol.
Returns (structuredContent): { ticker, company, exchange, sector, industry, moonshotScore|null, grade, band, scoreEngine, scoreAsOf, pillars: [{ pillar, score, state }], strongestPillar, weakestPillar, scoreRead, bullCase, bearCase, analysisDate, nextEarningsDate, figuresAsOf, canonicalUrl, fullFigures, disclaimer }.
Errors: "No summary for <ticker>" when the ticker is unknown or its page is too thin to publish. Funds/ETFs/warrants/SPACs carry no MoonshotScore (moonshotScore = null).
Derived output only: Stock Expert AI's own ratings, sentences and dates. Raw market figures (price, market cap, P/E, EPS, revenue) are not returned — full figures on the page (canonicalUrl).
MoonshotScore is Stock Expert AI's educational research rating, not a buy or sell recommendation. Not financial advice. Not a registered investment adviser.

ticker.description: US ticker symbol, e.g. NVDA, BRK.B, AAPL (case-insensitive)

tools.name: stockexpertai_compare_stocks
tools.description:
Compare 2-4 US stocks on Stock Expert AI's own metrics: MoonshotScore, Council Score, band, the five pillar scores (business quality, financial safety, valuation, growth durability, momentum; 0-100, sector-relative), sector, industry — plus a rule-based verdict sentence that states which ticker leads on how many metrics (it rates, it never recommends). Price, market cap and P/E are not returned: full figures on the comparison page (canonicalUrl).

Covers questions such as "CRM vs NOW", "AMD or NVDA, which scores higher", "compare AAPL MSFT GOOGL".
Args: tickers (array of 2-4 strings).
Returns (structuredContent): { asOf, verdict, metrics: [{ metric, values: {TICKER: value}, leader }], summaries: [one per-stock summary per ticker], missing, canonicalUrl, fullFigures, disclaimer }.
Errors: fewer than two tickers resolved → lists which ones were unknown.
Derived output only: Stock Expert AI's own ratings, sentences and dates. Raw market figures (price, market cap, P/E, EPS, revenue) are not returned — full figures on the page (canonicalUrl).
MoonshotScore is Stock Expert AI's educational research rating, not a buy or sell recommendation. Not financial advice. Not a registered investment adviser.

tools.name: stockexpertai_screen_stocks
tools.description:
Return one of Stock Expert AI's ranked lists — the same rows as the site's "Best ... Stocks" pages — for a sector, industry, theme or strategy. Every answer states the exact filter it applied (rankedBy + criteria) and its as-of date.

Cuts (each is a site-wide list; the numeric filter is returned with the rows): best = the scope's list ranked by MoonshotScore · undervalued = P/E ≤ 18, market cap ≥ $1B · dividend = dividend yield 1.5%-12%, market cap ≥ $2B, ranked by yield · high-growth = revenue growth ≥ 15%, market cap ≥ $1B · small-cap = market cap $300M-$2B. Cuts other than "best" are market-wide: a sector or theme scope is not applied to them (scopeApplied=false says so).
Scopes for cut=best: the 11 sectors (technology, healthcare, financial, energy, consumer discretionary, industrial, real estate, utilities, materials, communication, consumer staples), themes (ai, semiconductors, ev, renewable energy, cybersecurity, cloud computing, biotech, cannabis, quantum computing, space, robotics, fintech, metaverse, water) and strategies (dividend, growth, value, penny, blue chip, momentum, defensive, small/mid/large cap, low volatility, undervalued, under 10, under 50).
Covers questions such as "best semiconductor stocks", "undervalued stocks", "top MoonshotScore stocks in healthcare". The rows are a rating order, not picks to buy.
Args: scope (string); cut (enum, default "best"); limit (int 1-20, default 10).
Returns (structuredContent): { scope, cut, rankedBy, criteria, scopeApplied, asOf, rows: [{ rank, ticker, company, moonshotScore, canonicalUrl }], canonicalUrl, fullFigures, disclaimer }. Rows carry no price, market cap or P/E: full figures on the list page and on each row's stock page.
Errors: "No screen for <scope>" — the scope is not one of the site's lists (the accepted names are listed above).
Derived output only: Stock Expert AI's own ratings, sentences and dates. Raw market figures (price, market cap, P/E, EPS, revenue) are not returned — full figures on the page (canonicalUrl).
MoonshotScore is Stock Expert AI's educational research rating, not a buy or sell recommendation. Not financial advice. Not a registered investment adviser.

scope.description: Sector, industry, theme or strategy, e.g. technology, semiconductors, dividend

tools.name: stockexpertai_get_earnings
tools.description:
Earnings dates for one US stock the site covers: the next report date as listed by the data provider (nextReportConfirmed is true when that date falls inside the next 100 days — the window in which companies have normally announced it; longer-range dates are projections and can move) and the date of the last reported quarter. Consensus estimates, EPS actual vs estimate and surprise are not returned: full figures on the earnings page (canonicalUrl).

Covers questions such as "when does NVDA report earnings", "when did AAPL last report", "NVDA earnings date".
Args: ticker (string).
Returns (structuredContent): { ticker, nextReportDate|null, nextReportConfirmed, lastReportDate|null, asOf, canonicalUrl, fullFigures, disclaimer }.
Errors: "No earnings data for <ticker>" when the ticker is not covered or no report history is cached.
Derived output only: Stock Expert AI's own ratings, sentences and dates. Raw market figures (price, market cap, P/E, EPS, revenue) are not returned — full figures on the page (canonicalUrl).
MoonshotScore is Stock Expert AI's educational research rating, not a buy or sell recommendation. Not financial advice. Not a registered investment adviser.

tools.name: stockexpertai_search_ticker
tools.description:
Resolve a company name (or a partial ticker) to US ticker symbols covered by Stock Expert AI, e.g. "Nvidia", "Micron", "Berkshire".
Args: query (string, 1-80 chars); limit (int 1-10, default 5).
Returns (structuredContent): { query, matches: [{ ticker, company, exchange, canonicalUrl }] }.
Errors: empty matches — the company may not be US-listed or the name may need to be more specific.
Derived output only: Stock Expert AI's own ratings, sentences and dates. Raw market figures (price, market cap, P/E, EPS, revenue) are not returned — full figures on the page (canonicalUrl).
